scope: CRC-good VRL3 kind3 payload,512B in currentf0 physical framing; first32B significant and rest ignored padding. No reverse TX.

fields.name: flags
fields.value_or_semantics: LE; bit0 feedback_enabled must0; bit1 advertises candidate periodic forward-timebase metadata (see g0_forward_timebase_candidate_stage1.json); remaining noncritical bits ignored

fields.name: mapping
fields.value_or_semantics: 0=current no-interleave block identity admission; packet_seq is independent

fields.name: range_serial
fields.value_or_semantics: LEuint32 half-range advance; exact repeats allowed without age reset/reopen

identity: session_id comes from CRC-good32B VRL3 header already checked against protected PHY envelope; block owner uses full32bit fec_block_id.
scope_limits: Not final PC/PL/PS schema generation or freeze
Immediate previous-session tombstone only; full production session lifetime policy pending
Range announcement does not imply whole AU required
Capacity collision yields local code6 event/busy counter; missed announcements can be retried by repeating the descriptor, no infinite wait

replacement_range_lifetime_policy.current_window: CRC-good accepted descriptor replaces DATA admission [first_block,first_block+block_count), modulo32; existing data admission rule unchanged.
replacement_range_lifetime_policy.loading_outside_window: Rotating8-bank scan seals only eligible LOADING owners; emit committed sources, terminal code1 with missing bitmap if fewer thank, normal terminal/release acknowledgment before reuse.
replacement_range_lifetime_policy.queued_or_working_outside_window: Finish the existing finite job; no direct cancellation, source revocation or live overwrite. Absolute500ms/active20ms bounds remain.
replacement_range_lifetime_policy.bad_CRC_or_stale_descriptor: No change to window or bank lifetime.
replacement_range_lifetime_policy.repeat: No age reset or completed-block reopening; a repeated descriptor can retry a declaration after the prior owner releases.
replacement_range_lifetime_policy.closed_block_late_packets: Outside-window DATA remains unadmitted; already complete SOURCE and DMA records retain their ownership.
